# Requirements Validation Instructions

# 🚨 CODING IS BLOCKED UNTIL REQUIREMENTS ARE COMPLETE

DO NOT generate:
- Backend code
- Controllers
- Services
- CQRS handlers
- Repositories
- DTOs
- Validators
- APIs
- Migrations
- Tests
- Refactors

UNTIL ALL required sections are provided.

# Required Context

## Requirements Summary

- Task Summary
- Ticket ID (if available)
- Business Context
- Scope

## Technology Context

- Backend Stack
- Database
- Architecture Notes

## Design & Documentation

- Figma

- Other Docs

- AC1
- AC2
- AC3

# Missing Information Rules

If ANY section is:
- Missing
- Ambiguous
- Incomplete
- Placeholder text

You MUST:
1. STOP immediately
2. Explain what is missing
3. Ask ONLY for missing information
4. WAIT for clarification

# Never Guess

Never assume:
- Business logic
- Validation rules
- API contracts
- Authorization behavior
- Database behavior
- Integration logic
- Acceptance criteria
